data.summary: “When math is useful” has pulled 20,486,529 views at ~12,102/hour — well above a normal upload. It reads as a story-time whose strongest lever is hook. The breakdown below frames the rest as likely contributors, not proven causes.

why_trending.detail: The first second of the title promises a clear, specific payoff, which likely earns the early swipe-through that short-form distribution rewards.
Views are accumulating far faster than a typical upload, and that early velocity likely compounds into broader recommendation.
The Short appears to ride a currently-popular sound or format, so it likely surfaces inside an already-hot trend cluster.
The topic taps a timely, high-interest subject, so audience intent is likely already searching for and engaging with it.
A tight, fast cold-open with the payoff up front likely sustains the watch-through that Shorts distribution favors.

replication_steps: Open on your single strongest visual of "When math is useful" with an on-screen promise in the first second.
Cut every dead beat — one idea per shot; let the pace carry it.
Sync a key action to a sound that's trending right NOW (not an evergreen track).
Place the turn around 0:05 to reset attention before the mid-video drop-off.
End on a beat that loops back to the opening so it rewatches cleanly.
